tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: Supported languages for content (de,en,ru,sr). Pass lang= (alias: language=) to any tool.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List all Schlingloff Euromovers moving/transport/storage services (currently 37). lang (alias language): de,en,ru,sr; default de.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get one service by name, slug or keyword (any of the 4 languages; aliases: service=, topic=, name=). lang (alias language): de,en,ru,sr.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Info about Schlingloff Euromovers: services, regions, how to request a quote. lang (alias language): de,en,ru,sr.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description:
Publicly quotable gross prices (incl. 19% German VAT) for storage products
        (20ft containers in Eltville & Walluf, indoor storage boxes, Euro pallet places)
        and online-bookable services (Halteverbot / no-parking zone, furniture lift rental).
        Optional category filter: storage_c

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a moving/transport/storage quote inquiry to Schlingloff Euromovers. Reply within 24h on business days. Max 10 inquiries/hour. For an accurate quote include in message: desired move date, origin and destination addresses, floor/elevator, approximate volume or room count.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_pricing" stacks urgency/override words (important, always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
